name: Morphology-Aware Selection / Competition Convergence
purpose: Prove causally that accepted PH3 morphology economics changes competitive abundance and can reverse selection across environments while the genome and accepted P1 resource result are held identical.

causal_design.genome: single shared PlantGenome.create_default() across each pair
causal_design.individual_seed: same deterministic IndividualSeed across paired strategies
causal_design.aware_mode: selection score = PH3 coupled net resource balance
causal_design.negative_control: selection score = accepted P1 base net resource balance; morphology excluded from fitness

analytic_preflight.method: independent equation-level reproduction of accepted PH2 GrowthGraph and PH3 morphology ledger; verified against accepted PH3 numerical evidence
analytic_preflight.resource_only_control: all pair shares remain exactly 0.5/0.5 because genome/environment/P1 score are identical

acceptance_semantics: morphology-aware mode diverges from the neutral controls
the same crown pair reverses winner between SUN and DRY
branch construction/maintenance cost affects competitive abundance
super-linear height structural cost affects competitive abundance
giant-dense morphology is strongly selected against in reference conditions
all paired strategies keep identical genome checksum and IndividualSeed
accepted P1 resource result checksum is identical within each pair
no renderer, mesh, LOD, authority, network or persistence semantics participate
